🦀 Alt Codes & Keyboard Emoji Codes

Hamare YouTube Shorts wale saare keyboard emoji codes yahan hain. Symbol copy karo ya code se khud banao.

Is page par 65 shortcuts hain. Search box mein likh kar dhoondo aur Copy dabao.

Windows Alt Codes

Kaise use karein: Alt daba kar rakho, number pad (right side wale number) se code likho, phir Alt chhod do. Laptop mein number pad nahi hai to Fn / Num Lock on karo.

MS Word Emoji Codes (Alt + X)
